title: 林中惊起 · 光影版
revision: Add spatially varying canopy illumination, gentle cloud shadows, broken leaf highlights, shallow woodland haze and small projected bird shadows while retaining branch contacts and the fixed camera.
production: Local 2D lighting and composited animation using previously generated native artwork; no new image generation or video-generation service used.

lighting.direction: Consistent upper-left sunlight and lower-right projected bird shadows
lighting.cloudShadows: Soft spatially varying periodic transmission; different parts of the canopy brighten and darken at different times
lighting.surfaceResponse: Illuminated leaves receive more direct light than dark understory; cooler ambient component is retained in shadow
lighting.leafHighlights: Small changes restricted to existing bright leaf surfaces, synchronized with the periodic leaf-light pattern
lighting.forestFloor: Two fixed soft pools of light with small broken illumination, affecting the passing animal's shading
lighting.air: Low-opacity warm shafts restricted mainly to dark gaps; this is a 2D atmospheric interpretation
lighting.birds: Soft alpha-derived wing shadows projected onto the canopy, softened and weakened with the interpreted flight height
lighting.limitations: Illustrative 2D relighting and projection, not physically traced 3D illumination. Existing artwork contains baked lighting.

motion.perchContacts: same seven manually reviewed branch positions as v16
motion.loop: All lighting fields, foliage movement and resting animal states match at both endpoints
